reserves.name: Paxos Global Dollar (USDG) (Hyperbeat-stated 1:1 backing; independent Paxos reconciliation unpublished)

reserveReview.reviewer: Pharos Listing Policy v2 PR-4 review
reserveReview.rationale: Hyperbeat's USD+ and USD+ Architecture documentation both state verbatim that 'beatUSD is a stablecoin issued by Paxos, backed 1:1 by USDG.' On-chain, the HyperEVM BoringVault (0x669abe85f96a9e3b34723f7be9bc6f250abc0cc1) is controlled by a Hyperbeat 3-of-5 Safe and holds only residual USDC, and Paxos does not list beatUSD on its public USDG transparency pages, so confidence remains manual-review until independent Paxos reconciliation is published.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer documentation stating 1:1 USDG backing, without independent attestation or on-chain proof of USDG escrow
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No independent Paxos attestation naming beatUSD, reserve segregation schedule, or balance-sheet reconciliation between HyperEVM BoringVault liabilities and Paxos USDG reserves has been published.
